Hi Sofia / Ben — great meeting you at Inference@Scale yesterday. Thanks for carving out time at the booth; enjoyed the product walkthrough. Quick recap from our side so we’re aligned: 

- Current priority: reduce per-recommendation cost and keep 95th-percentile latency <120ms for user-facing recommendations.
- Data constraints: product and user identifiers are PII-adjacent; you flagged that a VPC/private deployment would be preferred.
- Typical traffic: spiky e-commerce windows (Black Friday scale), baseline 50 qps, peak 400 qps.

Next steps I proposed on the call: 1) share a short pilot outline that maps to your latency and isolation needs, 2) a short technical Q/A with our runtime lead to validate model/quantization options, and 3) a timing/decision check from your side. I attached a 1-pager pilot outline and our SOC 2 summary for your security team.

Attachment stubs: [arcadia-pilot-outline.pdf (3 pages)], [redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (2 pages)]

Proposed window for the technical Q/A: Nov 9–12 (30–45m). If those don’t work, tell me your priority/timing and I’ll adapt.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the conversation.

Priya — thanks for sending this up. A couple quick notes I added to the pilot outline:

- Add explicit latency SLO row (p95 < 120ms) and a simple throughput plan for 50/200/400 qps.
- Call out KV-cache benefits for repeated recommendation contexts; this should help cost on long sessions.
- Security: Neha, can you flag anything else the Arcadia SOC team will likely request?

If they’re asking for a private deployment we’ll want to pre-validate network egress and a basic IP allowlist flow. I’ll also prepare a short runbook we can attach if they need operational detail.
